name: How long does a sliding door leak repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a sliding door leak repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sliding door leak repair depends on the complexity of the issue. Simple fixes, like replacing weatherstripping or clearing drainage, can often be completed within a few hours. More involved repairs, such as frame reconstruction, glass replacement, or addressing adjacent structural damage, might take a full day or require multiple visits. We aim to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring a lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs can take a few hours, while more complex issues like frame or glass replacement may take a full day or longer.
